item.title: Drone fragments found on beach in Kiryat Haim
item.description:
Drone fragments were found this morning on the beach at the Langa site in Kiryat Haim as a result of activity by Rafael Advanced Defense Systems.
The company said the activity was routine and coordinated, adding that there was no danger in being near the fragments.

item.title: Police investigate suspected arson at waste disposal site near Be'er Sheva
item.description:
Several trucks caught fire yesterday at the Dudaim waste disposal site near Be'er Sheva.
Fire and Rescue Services suspected arson, and police have opened an investigation. Investigators believe the incident may have been criminally motivated.

item.title: Environment Ministry traps West Nile virus-infected mosquitoes in northern and central Israel
item.description:
The Environmental Protection Ministry reports that mosquitoes infected with the West Nile virus have been trapped in northern and central Israel.
“We urge the public to ensure that standing water around their homes is drained and to report any mosquito hazards to their local authorities," the ministry said.

item.title: Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus to be laid to rest at 1 p.m. in Haifa military cemetery
item.description:
Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus, who was killed during operational activity in southern Lebanon, will be laid to rest at 1 p.m. at the military cemetery in Haifa.
The family will sit shiva at 43 HaNoter Street in the Kiryat Haim neighborhood of Haifa.
